thread:
dana_sales: Quick sync - MeridianBank procurement wants a compact assurance pack for the POC: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (they attached a one-pager), and a one-page network diagram. Deadline 7 business days. Also asked for a Dedicated trial uplift. Who can sign the pen-test attestation?

mark_security: We can provide redacted SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt. For the pen-test attestation we need exact scope (hostnames/CIDRs) and confirmation whether Dedicated is in scope.

sydney_ops: If they want active scans against our infra we need source CIDRs, a scheduled window, and a contact. Otherwise presigned upload is easier. I can create the bucket/runbook once scope is final.

noor_legal: I can sign the attestation. Requirements: (1) final scope wording, (2) PO or signed POC note referencing engagement, (3) confirmation we are signing an attestation (not a warranty). Turnaround 48-72 hrs after receipt.

pricing-bot: pricing: Estimated Dedicated 2-week trial uplift = +22% over hosted list price (depends on GPU SKU). Will prepare formal quote after SKU confirmed.

dana_sales: They listed scope as "*.staging.meridian-bank.com" and said "include dedicated pool if used". Procurement prefers hosted but may upgrade. I'll ask for PO and whether they insist on scans or will accept uploads.

mark_security: Draft scope for legal: "Scope: testing limited to staging.meridian-bank.com and associated staging infrastructure for MeridianBank POC. Production systems and customer data are out-of-scope. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly purchased and referenced in the PO." Approve?

noor_legal: That language is fine. We'll not sign anything that permits production scans. If they require full unredacted reports we will need an NDA and internal review.

sydney_ops: Once scope is final I'll create presigned bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/meridianbank/ and a short runbook with allowed window, upload steps, and emergency contact.

dana_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll request PO and confirm scan method. Expect update by EOD.

mark_security: Next steps: @dana_sales get PO or signed POC note + confirm Dedicated yes/no. @noor_legal will sign after scope+PO. @sydney_ops will prep presign/runbook.

dana_sales: On it :thumbsup:
